numbers.SPEED: On one GPU the full pipeline takes 11.0~s per 2048$\times$2048 image (35 minutes for the 180 test images, model loading included). Run from the repository weights in a fresh environment, it reproduces the submitted file: 1,243 of 1,243 submitted instances are matched, with a mean IoU of 0.9983 (741 masks are identical; the rest differ by a few boundary pixels because of GPU arithmetic).
